verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe deduplication keys that stop duplicate alerts from creating new alerts while the original is active. They also describe alert grouping that collects related alerts into one alert group, which is triaged, escalated and attached to an incident once, with escalation paths routing pages to the right on-call person. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that grouping and dedup actually cut paging noise, and detail on how grouping rules (time windows, matching attributes) are configured.
